Run your AI models in LUMI supercomputer with Aitta

AI inference platform Aitta is a general purpose scalable service component of LUMI to host AI models for the research and development purposes.

Ease of use

Use LUMI supercomputer powers with easy Web UI and OpenAI-compatible API.

Efficiency

Resource allocation on demand from the European LUMI supercomputer and scalable microservice cloud for running the models in most suitable backend.

Security

Runs inside ISO/IEC 27001 certified datacenter.
